subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The manager said to her, “Will you accept the revised salary?”

options.text: The manager asked her whether she accepted the revised salary.
The manager asked her whether she would accept the revised salary.
The manager asked her whether she has accepted the revised salary.
The manager asked her whether she will accept the revised salary.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The manager asked her whether she would accept the revised salary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in indirect speech, which means that the verb tense and pronouns need to be changed.
 
• The given interrogative sentence is in direct speech.
 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for interrogative sentence conversions.
 
 
• Inverted commas are removed in indirect speech. 
 
• The reporting verb "said to" is changed to "asked."
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• To make the indirect speech for questions that can be answered in YES/NO, the word "if" or "whether" is used before the reported speech within the sentence.
 
• "Will" remains "would."
 
• Structure__: 
 
 
• (Will + Subject+ V1 + Object?) (Direct Speech)
 
• (Whether + Subject + would + V1 + Object ) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He said to Rahul "Will you help me?"*
 
• *He asked Rahul whether he would help me.*
 
 
 
 
 
• The pronoun **"you"** becomes **"she."**
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

The correct answer is ***"T******he manager asked her whether she would accept the revised salary." ***
